library.favourites.empty.desc: Star a song in any list, or on Now Playing, to find it here. Your Jellyfin favourites and YouTube Music likes appear here too.
library.playlists.empty.desc: Right-click a Library song and choose Add to playlist to start one. Playlists from Jellyfin and YouTube Music appear here too.
youtubeMusic.title: YouTube Music
youtubeMusic.search.label: Search YouTube Music
youtubeMusic.account.title: Your YouTube Music account
youtubeMusic.account.description: Add your saved YouTube Music songs and playlists to the shared Library. Stars sync with your YouTube Music likes. Imported playlists are read-only; you can group them and choose their pictures in Janis. Search and browse the YouTube Music source without an account.
youtubeMusic.account.instructions: Sign in to YouTube Music in your browser's normal profile, choose that browser below, then import your saved songs and playlists. Browser import requires yt-dlp, an optional tool installed separately and available on PATH. Janis never asks for your Google password.
youtubeMusic.account.browserPrivacy: Your browser or system keyring may need permission to read cookies. Janis keeps a private managed copy containing only cookies for youtube.com and its subdomains. For browser import, you do not need to export or keep a cookie file yourself.
youtubeMusic.account.manualInstructions: You can also import a Netscape cookie file manually. Keep that file available: Janis remembers its path to reconnect.
youtubeMusic.account.warning: Cookies grant access to your account. Use only your own signed-in browser or cookie file, keep cookies private and never share them. Disconnecting removes this integration's songs and imported playlists from the Library; local playlists and groups stay.
youtubeMusic.browser.label: Browser
youtubeMusic.status.importingBrowser: Importing YouTube cookies from your browser…
youtubeMusic.status.syncing: Reading your saved YouTube Music songs and playlists…
youtubeMusic.status.credentialsRejected: YouTube Music rejected these cookies. Sign in to YouTube Music in your browser, then import from the browser or a fresh cookie file.
youtubeMusic.status.failed: YouTube Music could not complete the request. Check your connection and try again.
youtubeMusic.empty.search: Search for a song or artist to find music to play.
youtubeMusic.error.initialization: The YouTube Music client could not be started.
youtubeMusic.error.cookieFile: The cookie file could not be read. Import an accessible cookie file.
youtubeMusic.error.browserImport: Browser import failed. Check that yt-dlp is installed and available on PATH, sign in to YouTube Music in the browser's normal profile, and allow browser or keyring access if requested. You can also import a cookie file manually.
youtubeMusic.error.invalidCookies: This file does not contain valid YouTube cookies.
youtubeMusic.error.network: YouTube Music could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
youtubeMusic.error.unavailable: This content is unavailable for this account or region.
youtubeMusic.error.unsupportedAudio: This track has no supported unencrypted AAC/M4A audio.
youtubeMusic.error.response: YouTube Music returned a response Janis could not read.
youtubeMusic.error.library: The YouTube Music library could not be updated. Try syncing again.
youtubeMusic.error.input: This YouTube Music request is invalid.
youtubeMusic.error.page: This page belongs to a different YouTube Music session. Reload the list.
youtubeMusic.error.artworkAddress: This artwork address is not supported.
youtubeMusic.error.artworkSize: The artwork exceeds the download limit.
youtubeMusic.error.extractorUnavailable: Install yt-dlp and make it available on PATH to play YouTube Music or import cookies from a browser.
